entities.name: ThiEC bifunctional enzyme
observations: Query sequence (768 aa) has a 87.4%-identity homolog over 99.9% query coverage to reviewed Bifidobacterium longum ThiEC (UniProt Q8G7X1).
Reviewed homolog annotation: ThiEC condenses THZ-P and HMP-PP to thiamine monophosphate (EC 2.5.1.3); also catalyzes radical-SAM formation of HMP-P from AIR (EC 4.1.99.17).
Reviewed homolog binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit, coordinated by three cysteines and exchangeable SAM.

entities.name: Thiamine phosphate assembly
observations: THZ-P + HMP-PP + H+ → thiamine phosphate (TMP) + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:22328); variant carboxylated THZ substrates yield TMP, CO2, and diphosphate (RHEA:47844, RHEA:47848). Homolog annotation, not direct assay of query.

entities.name: HMP-P biosynthesis
observations: AIR + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → HMP-P + CO + 5′-deoxyadenosine + formate + L-methionine (Rhea RHEA:24840); radical-SAM activity annotation from the reviewed homolog.
This is the separate pyrimidine-forming activity of the bifunctional enzyme; exact attribution to the query is homology-based.
